rv.q: It adds grit to a crowd-pleasing show.
If Burns was the flame, they were the firewood—and this afternoon, Pitlochry burned bright.
The latest staging of Sunshine On Leith, meanwhile, brilliantly celebrates the raw, handmade quality of a show made for 14 actor-musicians working with instruments in hand...

cn.t: Critics praise this Burns Night tribute for its engaging musical storytelling, despite a contrived premise of three women in the poet's life meeting at his grave. Strong performances and arrangements overcome the historical liberties taken.
